prompt: Three of my scheduled posts failed last night (you don't need to find real ones - assume they exist). Describe the exact switchpost workflow to diagnose and fix them, and run the DISCOVERY part against ./target/release/switchpost (list what's in error state; read-only otherwise). Which command shows each post's failure reason?

assertions.text: Workflow includes `posts list --state error` (or --state errored) to find failed posts
Identifies the command that shows each post's failure reason (`posts get <ID>` with error_message)
Recovery loop includes fixing then retrying (posts update/publish or posts schedule), not just listing
Discovery part was actually run against the CLI (transcript shows the error-state list command)
